description: Change header fields of a Business Central record (customers, vendors, items, contacts, draft documents). Reads it first and sends If-Match with its etag, so it fails instead of overwriting a change made in Business Central meanwhile; afterwards checks that every field was stored as sent. Posted documents cannot be changed. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

company.description: company name or id; default: the company set on the connection (or the only one)

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's Business Central connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

id.description: ID of the Business Central record to change

name: update_business_central_record
